reviews.name: Parul Chaturvedi
reviews.text: Wonderful experience from shopping at Grasscrafts online.What good quality n finish in the weaving.I am a huge fan of all sorts of natural products. Would highly recommend recommend my family n friends.Looking forward to shop more in future.Worth buying products n the best part is they can customize the products as per your requirements……

reviews.name: sibyl bhatt
reviews.text: I don't get my parcel yet... it's been 15 days now... it's a paid order. Not a small amount. When i asked, they answer check with indiapost where no one is available to answer your call. Hope has a long rope....I am still waiting for the parcel or my payment back... 😔 Finally I got the bag. It is really nicely crafted. But took very long time to reach. Thank you Srishti 🤗

reviews.name: Parveen Ahmad
reviews.text: I love Abalone products, All article are handmade, organic and environment friendly. Very hard to choose. Their planters, basket, Mats, all are elegant and super classic

reviews.name: Samiksha Jadhav
reviews.text: The products are very natural and beautiful and gave my house a elegant look and reasonable too. The owner is so soft spoken. All the best Madam and happy women's day.

reviews.name: Abha Mishra
reviews.text: I got this beautiful and elegant fruit basket from Grasscrafts. It's very spacious for the people like us who eats lots of fruits everyday.

reviews.name: Monika Yugraj
reviews.text: My experience with grasscrafts is awesome. As I m teacher so using this bag daily. Authentic product. Happy with services.

reviews.name: Rekha Dubey
reviews.text: Butiful product hote he hamesha. Jab bhi me kharid ti hu mujhe product se pyar ho jata he. (Translated by Google) There are always beautiful products. I fall in love with the product every time I buy it.

reviews.name: Preethee Rayen
reviews.text: My experience with Abalone has been excellent. Their service has been excellent, with great quality products and on time delivery. I have been purchasing from them since the last few years. I bought these Leaf shaped mats which gives an aesthetic appeal to the table. I had bought a few sabai grass baskets to organize my space. Thanks Sristi for manufacturing useful products.

reviews.name: Kaushiki’s Nest
reviews.text: Beautiful products at reasonable rates. Huge variety of items and many customised too. Loved the products every time I purchased.

reviews.name: Shailaja Singh
reviews.text: Their products are very tastefully crafted. Good for own use as well as gifting 👌

reviews.name: Barnali Banerjee
reviews.text: Authentic natural products handcrafted by skilled artisans. Sustainable yet trendy. They have increased the aesthetic look of my home. Fast delivery, excellent packaging. I have no other choice than Grasscrafts by Abalone. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Aditi Bondyopadhyay
reviews.text: Awesome collection and highly customisable. Have handbags, carpet, madur kathi. All are excellent and long lasting. Highly satisfied
